basic_details.job_title: Vigilance Department Mizoram Director Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: IPS Officer holding an analogous post (deputation posting by the State Government), or MPS Officer of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 years regular service in the grade.
qualification.details: Qualification: IPS Officer holding analogous post (deputation posting by the State Government, as exists presently); OR MPS Officer of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 (five) years regular service in the grade Experience: For MPS Officers: at least 5 (five) years regular service in SAG or Selection Grade Age limit: Maximum 56 years | Other conditions: | Open to IPS Officers holding an analogous post and MPS Officers of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 years regular service in the grade

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form (Annexure-I) enclosed with the advertisement.
Attach a copy of the Performance Appraisal Report for the last 5 (five) years.
Get the certificate of the Administrative Department/Cadre Controlling Authority signed by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary.
Submit the application to the Vigilance Department through proper channel latest by 3rd January, 2027 (Sunday).
important_instructions: Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently Selection is liable to be cancelled if any information furnished is found false or misrepresented at a later stage

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: IPS Officer holding analogous post (deputation posting by the State Government, as exists presently); OR MPS Officer of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 (five) years regular service in the grade Experience: For MPS Officers: at least 5 (five) years regular service in SAG or Selection Grade Age limit: Maximum 56 years Other conditions: Open to IPS Officers holding an analogous post and MPS Officers of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 years regular service in the grade

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation basis initially for a period of 3 (three) years The period of deputation shall not exceed 3 years initially

content_sections.text: Copy of Performance Appraisal Report for the last 5 (five) years Self-attested copy of date of birth proof such as HSLC or Birth Certificate Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Copy of penalty order by the Disciplinary Authority, if any penalty was imposed in the 5 years before the last date Certificate of the Administrative Department/Cadre Controlling Authority signed by an officer not below Under Secretary rank

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently Selection is liable to be cancelled if any information furnished is found false or misrepresented at a later stage

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Vigilance Department Mizoram Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Vigilance Department Mizoram Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Vigilance Department Mizoram Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (Common Application Form for Appointment by Deputation) enclosed with the advertisement, pages 2-4) and send it to Vigilance Department, Government of Mizoram, Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO, Building No. 1, Second Floor, Room No.242, Aizawl, by through proper channel, to reach by 3 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: IPS Officer holding an analogous post (deputation posting by the State Government), or MPS Officer of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 years regular service in the grade.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to IPS Officers holding an analogous post and MPS Officers of SAG or Selection Grade with at least 5 years regular service in the grade.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation basis initially for a period of 3 (three) years. The period of deputation shall not exceed 3 years initially.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Anti-Corruption Bureau, Mizoram.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Copy of Performance Appraisal Report for the last 5 (five) years; Self-attested copy of date of birth proof such as HSLC or Birth Certificate; Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates; Copy of penalty order by the Disciplinary Authority, if any penalty was imposed in the 5 years before the last date; Certificate of the Administrative Department/Cadre Controlling Authority signed by an officer not below Under Secretary rank.
